definitions.rahu_deciding_authorities: For Rahu dasa results, the two deciding planets are (a) the lord of the nakshatra Rahu occupies and (b) the lord of the sign Rahu occupies.
definitions.dasa_relevance_principle: A dosha only matters if the planet causing it gets a dasa/bhukti within the native's relevant lifetime. A dosha whose dasa falls at age 90+ is practically irrelevant.

rules.name: Textbook house rule (first step only)
rules.contrast: Rahu in 6/8/12 is generally read as difficult (dishonour, losses, legal trouble).
rules.note: This is only the first step; many exceptions exist. Do not conclude from house alone.

rules.name: Deciding authorities override house
condition_any: Rahu's star lord and sign lord are in mutual kendra or trikona
Rahu's star lord aspects Rahu's sign lord (e.g. Jupiter aspecting Moon)
rules.result: Rahu dasa is yogic regardless of which house Rahu occupies - even the 8th or 12th.

rules.name: One authority hidden from Lagna
rules.condition: RAHU-DA-01 holds BUT one deciding authority is in 6/8/12 from Lagna
rules.result: Rahu dasa still good, but with friction from the person that planet signifies (e.g. Jupiter hidden -> one parent, typically mother in the example, opposes; the other wavers).

rules.name: Rahu in 8th is not automatic mangalya dosha
rules.condition: Rahu in 8th AND RAHU-DA-01 holds AND Rahu dasa running in marriageable age
rules.result: Marriage happens in Rahu dasa; married life is good. Often settles away from native place; following dasas may bring foreign/other-language region settlement.

rules.name: Accept the love match
rules.condition: Chart carries several apparent marriage doshas (e.g. lone Ketu in 2nd, lord_2 hidden, Rahu in 8th, Venus or own-sign Mercury in 7th) AND Rahu dasa is yogic AND native has a love interest
rules.result: Love marriage is advisable. Rejecting it and seeking an arranged match risks long delay, since matchmaking by dosha-counting will keep filtering this chart out.
rules.advice_tone: Present as guidance for parents, not a mandate.

rules.name: Dosha only via its dasa
examples: Venus in 7th (karako bhava nashti) does not act if Venus dasa doesn't come in the relevant age
Own-sign Mercury in 7th for a dual lagna does not create spouse trouble if Mercury dasa comes only after 90
rules.result: Ignore doshas whose dasa falls outside the relevant life window.

guidance: Ideal marriage window per the astrologer: roughly age 23-35.
Scrutinise the chart repeatedly before calling a dosha; the deciding-authority check often reverses the textbook reading.
open_questions_for_implementation: Should Ketu dasa use the same deciding-authority rule (star lord + sign lord)?
